top_signals.title: Fordham: Third US Carrier in Gulf Fits Trump Strategy
top_signals.summary:
A third US aircraft carrier has arrived in the Centcom area of operations, according to Axios. It comes as Iran targeted a US air base in Bahrain on Friday. But Tehran says it remains open to ending the conflict, now in its ninth month. Tina Fordham, Founder & geopolitical strategist at Fordham Global Foresight spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East & Africa on the possibility of a conflict resolution.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Nvidia Fallout, Anthropic IPO Squeeze Asian Chip Stocks Anew
top_signals.summary: Asia’s two chip-heavy stock markets came under renewed pressure on Monday, tracking US weakness amid Nvidia Corp.’s turmoil and as investors made room for Anthropic PBC’s much-anticipated share sale.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
